reuse.why: Extends the two existing holiday paths (getHolidayExdates and the isOff check in getDateWithSkippedWeekend) with monthUtils helpers instead of adding new machinery, though it adds no single 'is this day a holiday' predicate both could share.

duplication.why: The new MM-DD rule is implemented twice in different forms: by expanding each entry over a range of years in getHolidayExdates and by matching dayFromDate(day).slice(5) in isOff.

placement.why: All changes are in shared/schedules.ts, where holiday handling already lives.

scope.why: Only the holiday handling, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Two separately written interpretations of the holiday format must stay in sync, and the exdate expansion relies on an arbitrary 100-year horizon and a length === 5 format check.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Both existing holiday code paths are updated in place; no abstraction is skipped.

disguised_duplication.where: The 'MM-DD matches every year' rule appears as a per-year expansion loop in getHolidayExdates and as a slice(5) comparison in isOff inside getDateWithSkippedWeekend.
